scope: The ordinary Shop list, system Photos picker and on-device OCR used fictional input in the isolated Debug workspace. The scratch UI harness was the only testing source addition beyond the stated app and unit-test changes.

actualEntry.scope: This run predates the alert change. It selected the real photo, brought the OCR review into view, used Done, opted in, explicitly remembered the corrected spelling and applied the reviewed import. After restart the suggestion appeared while the item still had the original spelling, and Use changed the editable name.
actualEntry.terminalResult: 10 model passes and 1 UI failure while trying to query the compact opt-out popover's unavailable Cancel action.

finalReadback.scope: Reused the same saved fictional pickup and rule. Selecting the matching photo again showed the suggestion without applying it. Native alert Cancel kept the rule, named Forget removed it, and confirmed opt-out disabled memory across another relaunch.

archive.result: Unsigned Release archive succeeded. The compiled app passed executable, asset, privacy, environment and embedded extension checks.

connectedContributor.scope: Ordinary Debug target. Eight spelling store, eleven contributor request and seven account deletion tests passed. The current enrolled member and selected language bind the spelling review. Changing the review or locking access rejects the stale scope. Separate member, account, language and private-workspace storage survives unrelated deletion. A blocked local account purge can be retried after sign-out and the account marker rejects stale writes.
connectedContributor.compiledDebug: Executable, assets, privacy, environment and embedded extensions passed verification.

firstPhotosRun.scope: Production contributor capture views and an enrolled fictional household transport. The system Photos picker selected a fictional label. On-device OCR produced 2 tortiyas, and the next capture offered the explicitly saved correction without changing the field. Use changed the editable name to tortillas. Request review kept the original wording and count of two. Cancel kept the fixture at zero submitted requests. Forget removed the suggestion.
firstPhotosRun.terminalResult: One UI test failed before confirming opt-out. XCTest matched two accessibility nodes for the same destructive button. The screenshot shows one destructive button and one Cancel button in the native alert.

optOutFollowUp.scope: The same app source and a second fictional membership captured the actual photo, opted in and explicitly stored a rule. Cancel kept the rule. The confirmed native alert turned off memory, removed the rule and left the fixture with zero submitted requests.

otherAttempts.reason: The original photo result was offscreen and tapping Remember with the keyboard still open saved no rule. This led to visible result positioning, Done and independent spelling controls.
Native popover snapshot reported duplicate button semantics. Its screenshot showed the destructive action without a visible Cancel. The final build uses a native alert.

remaining: Physical VoiceOver focus and device testing.
Bilingual contributor device acceptance and a live enrolled household.
